name: Nessa Flintward
source_profile: ● Nessa Flintward (NG) is a dwarven Ranger and skilled mountain scout who maintains friendly relations with the Blackpick Claimholders. She frequently advocates restraint when dealing with disputed ancestral mines and has occasionally challenged her superiors over the treatment of independent prospectors.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 18 (source excerpt; may be partial)
